newsitem.title: CUBA: Loatian premier pledges solidarity with Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Loatian premier pledges solidarity with Cuba.

text.p: Loatian Prime Minister Khamtay Siphandone has ended a two-day official visit to Cuba, pledging continued solidarity with the fellow communist-ruled nation.

"We reaffirm that we will give our maximum efforts to maintain and increase the deep and firm friendship between our two countries," Cuban media quoted Khamtay as saying before leaving Havana on Sunday night.
He said Cuba had always given "support and assistance" to Laos.
